description: Start and end timestamps for a selected silver/copper stage.
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT well_name, stage_num, COALESCE(CAST(continuous_start_ts AS timestamp), CAST(stage_start_ts AS timestamp)) AS start_time, COALESCE(CAST(continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) AS end_time FROM featurestore:nextier_copper_stage_index_v1 WHERE well_name = :well_name AND stage_num = :stage_num AND COALESCE(CAST(continuous_start_ts AS timestamp), CAST(stage_start_ts AS timestamp)) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(CAST(continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) q
